title: delphinium elatum var. ranunculifolium
intro: Delphinium elatum var. ranunculifolium, commonly known as the delphinium or larkspur, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium elatum var. ranunculifolium include sedation, pain relief, and relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include delphinine, berberine, and other alkaloids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
